mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 66 degrees and foggy near Fireman's Park under a Waning Gibbous moon, and tonight we are looking at an overnight low of 64 degrees with rain in the forecast.
The city is currently coordinating cross connection control inspections to protect our water supply, and don't forget that early voting for the November 3 election is available at City Hall.
Looking ahead, tomorrow features Yoga at Insight Wellness, Art Bar Happy Hour, and trivia at Hop Haus, while the World Dairy Expo arrives this Saturday.
On September 24, an 11-year-old bicyclist was involved in a crash with a vehicle at Westward Drive, but thankfully they did not require hospitalization.
The Culver's kitchen has closed for the night after serving today's Double Strawberry, so check back tomorrow at 10:00 AM to enjoy the new flavor of the day, Chocolate Heath Crunch.
